## Description

Solves a continuous-time continuous-state Mean-Variance portfolio optimization problem using actor-critic reinforcement learning adapted to time-inconsistent Markowitz frameworks.

## Where it may fit

Dynamic rebalancing under continuous price shifts and state-dependent risk aversion constraints.

## Vehicles

Systematic Asset Management Funds, Quantitative Hedge Funds.

## Required data

Continuous asset price streams, risk-free rate curves, investor target return/variance parameters.

## Caveats

Time-inconsistency in mean-variance formulation requires pre-committed or game-theoretic equilibrium strategies.
